title: Uncle Morris: arrival, other bands, Jack Carey, and the Alamo
summary: Morris's origin in Laplace, his bands including Taft Kroon and Jack Carey, and French's work at the Alamo with Willie and John Joseph.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: We'll get into details about your life in a few minutes but while I still think I would let's ask some more about your Uncle Morris. Remember he was born up? He was born in Laplace.
And did he come down here about the same time as your father would you say?
I think they both came down around the same time.
Of course you might not, that was before you were born I guess anyway, wasn't it?

I think it was before I was born because when they came down it was before I was born because I was born here and well I just found out about where they're home was I mean about ten or twelve years after I was born.
Remember anything else about your Uncle Morris where he played or other bands besides Rene that he might have played in?

Well. Some of the bands, I know he played with one band up in Monroe, Taft Kroon, I know he played with Taft Kroon. And well he played with Rene and I think at times he used to play with Jack Carey. You remember Jack Carey? Yeah. Well sometimes he used to use two trombones. Two trombones. And he played with Jack Carey at certain times.
I never knew Jack Carey. I knew his brother Mutt though.
Yeah well I knew Mutt too. Mutt came down, I mean when I was working on Alamo and Mutt came down one or two times I think. I was working on Alamo with Kaizer. Remember Kaizer?
Oh yes. The Willie Joseph. Willie Joseph. His brother still plays John Joseph. John Joseph.
I knew him not very well but I heard him play a couple of times.
Very fine. Very fine bass player. And Willie Joseph was very fine. I worked at Alamo with him for three and a half years. I'm trying to think of what Morris is in a different band.
